memories.m_home: A kitchen, too quiet. You learned that being small and unseen was the safest way to be.
memories.m_bully: Someone once made the world feel unsafe. Lumen first woke up that day, standing between you and the noise.
memories.m_sibling: There was someone smaller than you who needed protecting. You remember holding their hand in the dark.
memories.m_night: The nights were the hardest. Wren learned to hum a song no one ever taught them.
memories.m_therapy: A warm room, a patient voice: 'You're not broken. You're many — and that's okay.'
memories.m_school: A classroom of staring faces. Sol stepped forward with the right words so you didn't have to.
memories.m_friend: Someone chose to stay. For the first time, the system let one person in.
memories.m_firstday: The first day somewhere new. Sol learned to read the room so the others could stay hidden.
